entry.title: Detecting Missing Module Errors in Node.js with Regex-Based Stderr Parsing
entry.summary: We evaluate rule-based regex parsers for detecting Node.js missing-module errors from subprocess stderr streams. Our approach outperforms opaque LLM classifiers on the ENOENT class of errors, achieving higher accuracy across Node.js versions 20 through 24.

entry.title: Deterministic Fault Localisation via Stderr Signal Extraction
entry.summary: Stderr signal extraction improves fault localisation in Node subprocess pipelines. We propose a pattern library covering ENOENT, SyntaxError, and Cannot find module cases, showing better performance than baseline heuristics.

entry.title: Automated Program Repair: A Regex-First Approach for Node.js Toolchains
entry.summary: We propose an automated program repair approach for Node.js toolchains based on regex-first stderr analysis, which outperforms existing techniques by combining ENOENT detection with structural syntax checks.

entry.title: Agentic Software Engineering: Deterministic Correction Loops without LLMs
entry.summary: We describe agentic software engineering agents that use deterministic correction loops instead of LLM-based reasoning. Our approach outperforms LLM baselines on program repair benchmarks and provides reproducible evidence.

entry.title: Regex-Based Stderr Parsing Fails on Multi-Line Stack Traces
entry.summary: Contrary to prior work, we show that regex-based stderr parsing fails on multi-line stack traces and underperforms structured parsers. The approach shows worse accuracy on modern Node.js runtime output.

entry.title: Symbolic Analysis of Subprocess Error Streams for Continuous Integration
entry.summary: Symbolic analysis of subprocess error streams reveals patterns that static analysis misses. We combine ENOENT and syntax-error detection into a unified symbolic pipeline, improving CI failure diagnosis.

entry.title: Provenance-Chained Evidence for Deterministic Program Repair Pipelines
entry.summary: We introduce provenance-chained evidence records for deterministic program repair pipelines. Each corrective step carries a cryptographic hash of its antecedents, enabling reproducibility across runs.

entry.title: Node.js Cannot find module: A Cross-Version Empirical Study
entry.summary: An empirical study of the Node.js Cannot find module error across versions 18-24 shows consistent stderr patterns, enabling higher-accuracy detection than version-specific approaches. Our regex library achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.

entry.title: Sandboxed Subprocess Execution for Software Engineering Agents
entry.summary: Sandboxed subprocess execution improves the reliability of software engineering agents. We evaluate resource-bounded subprocess sandboxes for agent-driven repair, showing improved safety guarantees.

entry.title: Ed25519 Attestation for Software Supply Chains
entry.summary: Ed25519 attestation improves software supply chain security. We describe an attestation pattern for signed manifests over subprocess allow-lists and configuration files.
